def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    start = player_id * 6
    other = (1 - player_id) * 6
    board = state_view.board
    parity_lead = (board[start] + board[start+2] + board[start+4] - board[start+1] - board[start+3] - board[start+5]) - (board[other] + board[other+2] + board[other+4] - board[other+1] - board[other+3] - board[other+5])
    store_lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[1-player_id]
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, (parity_lead + 0.5 * store_lead) / 4.0))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    start = player_id * 6
    other = (1 - player_id) * 6
    board = state_view.board
    own_power = board[start + 0] * board[start + 0] + board[start + 1] * board[start + 1] + board[start + 2] * board[start + 2] + board[start + 3] * board[start + 3] + board[start + 4] * board[start + 4] + board[start + 5] * board[start + 5]
    opp_power = board[other + 0] * board[other + 0] + board[other + 1] * board[other + 1] + board[other + 2] * board[other + 2] + board[other + 3] * board[other + 3] + board[other + 4] * board[other + 4] + board[other + 5] * board[other + 5]
    store_lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[1-player_id]
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, (own_power - opp_power + store_lead) / 8.0))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    start = player_id * 6
    other = (1 - player_id) * 6
    board = state_view.board
    own_shape = board[start+2] + board[start+3] - board[start] - board[start+1] - board[start+4] - board[start+5]
    opp_shape = board[other+2] + board[other+3] - board[other] - board[other+1] - board[other+4] - board[other+5]
    store_lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[1-player_id]
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, (own_shape - opp_shape + 2.0 * store_lead) / 5.0))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    start = player_id * 6
    other = (1 - player_id) * 6
    board = state_view.board
    own_contrast = abs(board[start] - board[start+1]) + abs(board[start+2] - board[start+3]) + abs(board[start+4] - board[start+5])
    opp_contrast = abs(board[other] - board[other+1]) + abs(board[other+2] - board[other+3]) + abs(board[other+4] - board[other+5])
    store_lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[1-player_id]
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, (own_contrast - opp_contrast + store_lead) / 4.0))
